brief: 12 of the last 18 merge-queue runs failed, nearly every one on a different test; one shard process hit its 45-minute timeout; JS-158's deadlock was seen in 2 of 3 runs on 2026-11-22. Each failure costs about 45 minutes and a requeue. Options: move JS-158 ahead; a task that triages the recurring flakes into causes; both; leave as is. (brief-triage-0522.md)
tradeoff: Given up: about one task's worth of building goes to tests before the viewer-facing set starts, and JS-160 is built ahead of it. No viewer or operator loses anything.
serves: PRODUCT.md quality bar: 'Failure modes are designed, tested and reported. Nothing fails silently'; goal 1, since a product race (JS-159) was found among such failures.
entry: Option (c), bounded. JS-158 moves to 19 and starts now. JS-175 enters at 22: a verdict from the log for each of the 12 failed runs, product causes back as briefs with nothing in the product changed, a forcing check and a fix only for a test cause seen twice, reproduction within 8 hours, the timed-out shard split if its healthy time is within 10 minutes of the timeout (takes BL-175), and the next 10 queue runs counted. JS-160 moves to 24. No nightly run, retry or workflow change. Reopens on the 10-run count: 2 or fewer failures sends JS-160 back behind the viewer-facing set.
